name: Mare Imbrium
game_note: Sea of Showers; Apollo 15 landed at its edge. Home of Chang'e 3 and Lunokhod 1.

name: Mare Serenitatis
game_note: Sea of Serenity; Apollo 17 landed at its edge in Taurus-Littrow.

name: Mare Tranquillitatis
game_note: Sea of Tranquility; Apollo 11 landing site. Hosts a 100 m deep pit with room-temperature shadows.

name: Mare Crisium
game_note: Sea of Crises; fully flooded basin. Luna 24 sampled it; Blue Ghost landed there in 2025.

name: Mare Fecunditatis
game_note: Sea of Fertility; Luna 16 robotic sample return site.

name: Mare Nectaris
game_note: Sea of Nectar; one of the older maria (~3.9 Ga).

name: Mare Humorum
game_note: Sea of Moisture; unvisited by landers so far.

name: Oceanus Procellarum
game_note: Ocean of Storms - not a round basin but a vast volcanic province; Apollo 12 and Chang'e 5 landed here.

name: Mare Frigoris
game_note: Sea of Cold; stretches across the northern nearside.

name: Mare Vaporum
game_note: Sea of Vapours, near the centre of the nearside.

name: Mare Orientale
game_note: Eastern Sea - the youngest large basin; its bullseye rings are a textbook impact structure.

name: Mare Moscoviense
game_note: One of the very few maria on the far side - the crust there is thicker, so lava rarely flooded it.

name: Mare Ingenii
game_note: Sea of Cleverness, on the far side antipode of Mare Imbrium.

name: South Pole-Aitken Basin
game_note: Largest, oldest (about 4.3 Ga) and deepest basin on the Moon. Chang'e 6 sampled inside it. Not filled by lava: a window into the lower crust and mantle.
